SEBI receives over 3,500 responses on Closing Auction Session changes

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has received over 3,500 responses to its consultation paper on changes to the Closing Auction Session (CAS) mechanism. SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated that the regulator plans to move forward quickly with proposals based on this feedback. Pandey also indicated that SEBI is working with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to ease market access for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs).
